questions.question: The length of a cuboid is twice its breadth and its height is half of its breadth. If the height of the cuboid is 2 cm, then what is the edge of a cube having the same volume as that of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height = 2 cm

Height = breadth/2

Breadth = 4 cm

Length = 2 × Breadth = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

The volume of cuboid = Volume of cube

⇒ Length × Breadth × Height = (edge)³

**Calculation:**

⇒ (Edge)³ = 8 × 4 × 2 = 64

⇒ Edge = 4 cm

**∴ Edge of the cube is 4 cm.**

questions.question: A spherical ball of diameter 35 cm rolls 20 times. How much is the distance (in m) covered by it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the spherical ball = 35 cm.

No. of revolutions of the ball = 20 times.

**Concept used:**

distance covered by spherical ball = 2πr × number of revolution.

**Calculation:**

Diameter = 2 × radius

⇒ Radius = 35/2 cm

Now,

⇒ Distance covered by spherical ball = 2 times frac{{22}}{7} times frac{{35}}{2} times 20

⇒ Distance covered by spherical ball = 2200 cm = 22 m (∵ 100 cm = 1 m)

**∴ Distance covered by spherical ball is 22 m.**

questions.question: A cuboid of size 100 cm × 80 cm × 60 cm cut into eight identical parts by three cuts. What is the total surface area (in square cm.) of all eight parts?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Here l is length, b is breadth and h is height

**Calculation:**

The cuboid is cut from the middle of each face to get 8 identical cuboids

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf56adffc1086488f0acbebbe04d74b2753832c8d4aced4f06dc2ddbbd03cf9.png] 

Total surface area of each small cuboid = 2(50 × 40 + 40 × 30 + 30 × 50)

⇒ Total surface area of each small cuboid = 2× (4700) = 9400

Total surface area of 8 small cuboids = 8 × 9400 = 75200

**∴ The total surface area of all parts is 75200 cm²**

questions.question: A room is in the shape of cube and the length of the longest rod placed in it is 21√3 cm. Find the area of the floor.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A room is in the shape of a cube and the length of the longest rod placed in it is 21√3 cm

**Solution: **

Since the longest rod that can be placed inside a room is along the diagonal of the room

The length of the diagonal of the cubical room = length of the room

⇒ √3a = 21√3, where a is the length of the side of the room

⇒ a = 21

Since, the area of floor = a²

⇒ The area of floor = (21)²

**∴ The area of the floor is 441 cm².**

questions.question: The volume of a right pyramid is 45√3cm³ and its base is an equilateral triangle with side 6 cm. What is the height (in cm) of the pyramid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × 6² = 9√3 cm².

Volume = (1/3) × Base Area × Height.

45√3 = (1/3) × 9√3 × h.

45√3 = 3√3 × h ⇒ h = 15 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of right pyramid = 45√3 cm³

Side of equilateral triangular base (a) = 6 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × a²

Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × Area of Base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/142325e48df25aea84561de10a821dd57b1bb28b0f252636c204993645918ff7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of Base = (√3/4) × (6)²

⇒ Area of Base = (√3/4) × 36

⇒ Area of Base = 9√3 cm²

⇒ Volume of Pyramid = (1/3) × 9√3 × Height

⇒ 45√3 = (1/3) × 9√3 × Height

⇒ 45√3 = 3√3 × Height

⇒ Height = (45√3) ÷ (3√3)

⇒ Height = 15 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Pyramid

The slant height (l) is related to height (h) and the inradius (r) of the base by l² = h² + r².

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

LSA = (1/2) × Perimeter of base × Slant height.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

TSA = Lateral Surface Area + Base Area.

questions.question: The lateral surface area of a cylinder is 352 cm². If its height is 7 cm, then its volume (in cm) is ∶ Take π=22/7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LSA = 2πrh = 352 cm² and h = 7 cm.

Radius (r) = LSA ÷ (2 × π × h) = 352 ÷ (2 × 22/7 × 7) = 352 ÷ 44 = 8 cm.

Volume = πr²h = (LSA × r) ÷ 2 = (352 × 8) ÷ 2 = 176 × 8.

Volume = 1408 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1408 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of cylinder = 352 cm²

Height (h) = 7 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula:**

Lateral Surface Area = 2πrh

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cba71e82ecef4f1becabbe83b6bdd25755b536919294f1c48ff5737e0951a763.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r × 7 = 352

⇒ 44 × r = 352

⇒ r = 352 ÷ 44

⇒ r = 8 cm

⇒ Volume = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 8 × 8 × 7

⇒ Volume = 22 × 64

⇒ Volume = 1408 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1408 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the lateral area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of Cone

A cone with the same radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third its volume: Volume = (1/3)πr²h.

Base Area of Cylinder

The area of the circular base or top is given by the formula: Area = πr².</p

questions.question: A sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Volume of sphere = 4/3 π r³

Radius of bigger sphere R = 6 cm

and radius of smaller sphere = 2 cm

Suppose x small spheres made by the bigger sphere.

According to the question

⇒ 4/3 π r³ × x = 4/3 π R³

⇒ 4/3 × π × 2³ × x = 4/3 × π × 6³

⇒ x = 27

questions.question: The curved surface area and the slant height of a right circular cone are 99 cm² and 9 cm respectively. Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area of cone = 99 cm²

Slant height of the cone = 9 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where r → radius of the cone

l → slant height of the cone

**Calculation:**

⇒ πrl = 99

⇒ 22/7 × r × 9 = 99

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

∴ Diameter = 2 × 3.5 = 7 cm
